title: 小云雀 / Pippit CLI — subscription credit balance (read-only)
notes: Official pippit-tool-cli with its own login, bound as xyq: the same reviewed binding the built-in xyq.image and xyq.video use. No ATM API Key or vault unlock. Returns only total_remain_amount, a string: "0" is a real zero and a missing field is a failure. No generation, upload or purchase. The CLI exposes no renewal date.
completion: Credit balance returned; no generation submitted.
